name: plank on hands
description: A straight-arm plank held on the hands. It builds trunk stiffness and shoulder stability.
instructions: Place your hands under your shoulders and extend your legs behind you.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips so the body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then lower your knees.
